rec.name: Mobile Burger Menu with Image Icons, Accordion Sub-Navigation and Pinned Account Area
rec.status: Sketched — approved by client, handed to dev (build/launch not confirmed in ticket)

what.text: A restructured mobile burger (drawer) menu for a Shopify store on the Impact theme. Top-level items have round images in front of them and an arrow at the end. Tapping an item expands its sub-items downward as an accordion. Badges can sit in the bottom corner. Account and Login are placed in a fixed spot at the bottom. The groups are visually separated more clearly than in the original mobile menu, which was cluttered. The final sketch is not attached to the ticket, so this description comes from the comments.

why.text: On mobile the menu is often the main way to browse. A flat, crowded list forces extra scanning and taps, so visitors drop off before reaching a collection or product. Round images give quick visual cues, which cuts cognitive load and makes categories easier to recognise. Arrows signal that an item expands. Grouping and clear separation make a long hierarchy easier to scan. Putting account/login in a predictable place keeps secondary actions out of the way of the main navigation. Badges can draw attention to key items such as bundles or new products.

how.text: 1) Build the menu hierarchy in Shopify Navigation, with top-level items and nested children, as in the screenshot. 2) In the Impact theme's mobile drawer, add a round image or icon in front of each top-level link, using a menu-item image mapping or a custom Liquid snippet. 3) Add a chevron at the end of expandable items and make the children collapse and expand downward. 4) Add clear dividers or spacing between groups. 5) Add optional badge labels in the bottom corner. 6) Pin Account / Login at the bottom of the drawer. Impact's native mega-menu and drawer options only partly cover this, so custom Liquid/CSS is probably needed.

items: Menu hierarchy: top-level items with nested sub-items (Shopify Navigation)
Round image or icon per top-level item
Chevron/arrow at the end of expandable items
Optional badges in the bottom corner
Account/Login placement at the bottom of the drawer

dependencies.text: Impact Shopify theme (client is Sectionfy.io; the store is sectionfy-io-shop). Needs a Shopify Navigation menu with nested items. Images or icons per menu item need either a custom approach (metafields, a Liquid mapping by handle, or theme assets) or a theme setting. Whether the Impact theme supports this natively was not confirmed in the ticket.

items: Click-through rate per menu item and group
Mobile bounce rate and pages per session

images.caption: Shopify admin view of the menu structure: top-level groups with nested children, plus standalone items (Premium Services, Custom Development Request, Login). This is the content hierarchy the burger menu shows, not the final visual design.
